name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Holds back clicks that would kill you and sends them a few ticks later if that survives. F6 cycles strength.

start-strength.name: Starting strength
start-strength.description: Strength when a level starts. 0 = off, 1 = 1 frame, 2 = 2 frames, 3 = 4 frames, 4 = 8 frames. F6 cycles it in-game.

orb-prediction.name: Predict orbs, pads and gravity portals
orb-prediction.description: Lets the prediction use orbs, pads and gravity portals. Turn off if you notice glitches around them.

budget-ms.name: Prediction time limit (ms)
budget-ms.description: Most time spent predicting per click. Higher finds more saves at big strengths but can stutter on dense levels.

show-label.name: Show status label
show-label.description: Shows the current strength and the last saved click in the bottom-left corner.
